q: The muscular organ that pumps oxygenated and deoxygenated blood throughout the body is the ____. (P5)
explain: The human heart contracts continuously to pump blood through arteries and veins.

q: Blood vessels that carry oxygen-rich blood AWAY from the heart to the body tissues are ____. (P5)
explain: Arteries (like the aorta) transport high-pressure blood away from the ventricles.

q: Blood vessels that carry blood back TOWARD the heart are ____. (P5)
explain: Veins carry deoxygenated blood back into the atria with the help of one-way valves.
hint: Carry blood back to the heart.

q: In an ecosystem food chain, green plants that produce their own food using sunlight are ____. (P5)
explain: Plants produce organic biomass via photosynthesis, forming the base of the food chain.

q: Organisms that break down dead plants and animals into soil nutrients are ____. (P5)
explain: Bacteria and fungi decompose organic matter, recycling vital nutrients into soil.

q: Materials that allow electricity to flow through them easily are called electrical ____. (P5)
explain: Metals like copper and aluminum are good conductors because they have free electrons.

q: Materials like rubber, plastic, and wood that prevent electric current from flowing are ____. (P5)
explain: Insulators protect us from electrical shock.

q: The bending of light rays as they pass from air into water or glass is called ____. (P5)
explain: Refraction is the change in light wave speed and direction at a boundary.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): What is the chemical formula of pure water?
explain: H₂O is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Which organ pumps blood in the human body?
explain: Heart is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Which gas do humans inhale for cellular respiration?
explain: Oxygen is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Which gas do green plants absorb during photosynthesis?
explain: Carbon dioxide is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): What is the freezing point of pure water at sea level?
explain: 0°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): What is the boiling point of pure water at standard atmospheric pressure?
explain: 100°C is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The female reproductive cell in humans and animals is the ____.
explain: ovum (egg) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The male reproductive cell in animals is the ____.
explain: sperm is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Animals that eat ONLY plants are called ____.
explain: herbivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Animals that eat ONLY meat and other animals are called ____.
explain: carnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Animals that eat BOTH plants and meat are called ____.
explain: omnivores is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The largest organ of the human body is the ____.
explain: skin is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The framework of bones that supports and protects human organs is the ____.
explain: skeleton is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Sound cannot travel through a ____ because there are no particles to vibrate.
explain: vacuum (empty space) is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Which energy is obtained directly from the sun?
explain: Solar energy is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Which planet is the largest in our solar system?
explain: Jupiter is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): Which planet is famous for its bright, prominent rings?
explain: Saturn is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The process by which seeds begin to sprout and grow into young seedlings is ____.
explain: germination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma of a flower is ____.
explain: pollination is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The loss of water vapour from the leaves of plants through stomata is ____.
explain: transpiration is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The powerhouse organelle inside animal and plant cells that produces energy is the ____.
explain: mitochondrion is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The control center of a biological cell containing genetic DNA is the ____.
explain: nucleus is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The rigid outer protective layer found in plant cells but absent in animal cells is the ____.
explain: cell wall is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The force of attraction between any two masses in the universe is ____.
explain: gravitation is the scientifically verified fact.

q: Scientific inquiry (P5): The measure of how much matter is packed into a given volume is called ____.
explain: density is the scientifically verified fact.
